summary: Lower Jenkinson Street kerb with cars parked, houses about 10-15 m behind it.
reasons: Houses roughly 10-15 m on own side
Other cars park along this kerb

drivers.traffic: Residential street, one carriageway of a split road; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along this kerb in both images, so a van would blend in.
